title: test_fleet_guards: 048n reproduction mode vacuous on hosts without a UTF-8 folding locale
description: Security pass of 048n codereview (kimi-k3): scripts/test_fleet_guards_cycle_min.py:27,83-89 — the collation folding of multibyte digits into [0-9] requires a UTF-8 locale with glibc iso14651 collation (e.g. en_US.UTF-8); under C/POSIX (and byte-ordered C.UTF-8) ranges are codepoint-ordered and even the OLD pattern rejects. The BASH_ENV stub only runs 'shopt -u globasciiranges' and the test inherits ambient os.environ, so on a host whose LANG/LC_ALL lacks a folding locale (typical minimal CI containers) test_rejects_all_bad_forms_with_globasciiranges_off passes vacuously without exercising the 048n defect condition. Fix: stub should export LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 (or first available folding locale) with an explicit skip-if-unavailable, so the regression condition is guaranteed rather than host-dependent.
close_reason: Fixed: _folding_locale() in scripts/test_fleet_guards_cycle_min.py now discovers installed UTF-8 locales via 'locale -a' (en_US* preferred), and self-validates each candidate with an isolated probe of the pre-048n range pattern under globasciiranges off — a candidate is used only if it actually folds multibyte digits (old pattern PASSes ١٢٣). Verified on this host: en_US.utf8 selected, probe confirms folding. If no folding locale exists the test skips explicitly ('048n condition unreproducible') instead of passing vacuously. pytest 2/2 pass, offline.
